Я редко пишу плохие отзывы, наверное, это один из первых

4) абсолютно пофигистичное отношение к гостю, от тик-тока отлипнуть не получается))

В общем сюда ни ногой, прям по соседству слева есть заведение в котором тоже есть фо-бо. Там не пробовал, но выглядит чисто и опрятно, уж лучше сходить туда, потому что сделать фо-бо еще хуже надо постараться 😆
textTranslated:
I rarely write bad reviews, so this is probably one of the first.

Usually there are some flaws, but I prefer to ignore them in other areas; maybe I was just unlucky.

But this is a combo:
1) the place is empty, the hostess is on TikTok, the floor is littered with limes and napkins, like it hasn't been cleaned in a month. I understand it's normal for them to litter the floor, but is it really that hard to clean up when no one's around?

2) the pho-bo is absolutely mediocre, and for some reason it's peppered. I've lived in Vietnam for two years, and this is one of the worst pho bo I've ever had.

3) Well, I think it's probably 40-50 dong, which is understandable for a cafeteria, but I was so shocked when they quoted me 70,000 😆😆😆
By Vietnamese standards, this should be a completely different pho bo for that price.

4) Totally indifferent attitude towards the guest, I can't tear myself away from TikTok.

Basically, I'll never set foot here again. There's a place right next door on the left that also serves pho bo. I haven't tried it, but it looks clean and tidy. I'd rather go there, because you'd have to try really hard to make pho bo even worse. 😆

text:
這間是當地人都會來吃越南米線（粗寬的），生牛肉米線一碗vnd 60k (NT 78)，牛肉居然給的不少！（跟台南的小碗牛肉湯份量差不多）

桌上辣椒與檸檬片都可自行取用，但是*辣椒非常辣*，建議放1片到湯裡面泡一泡就可以拿出來，因為我們有人吃下去後就回到飯店餐廳再補牛奶解辣

當地人會加點油條一起吃，豆芽菜也可以請老闆多加一點。店內附免費冰綠茶

店內菜單越南文，可用圖片點餐，再比手勢數字（幾碗）

缺點：內用只有電風扇，會有些熱
喝茶的杯子，杯口較髒
textTranslated:
This is a popular local spot for Vietnamese rice noodles (thick and wide). A bowl of raw beef rice noodles costs VND 60k (NT$78), and the beef portion is surprisingly generous! (Similar in size to a small bowl of beef soup in Tainan).

Chili and lemon slices are available for self-service, but the chili is extremely spicy. It's recommended to soak one slice in the soup briefly before removing it, as some of us went back to the hotel restaurant to drink milk to cool down after eating.

Locals often add fried dough sticks to their meals, and you can ask the owner for extra bean sprouts. Free iced green tea is provided.

The menu is in Vietnamese; you can order by looking at pictures and then using hand gestures to indicate the number of bowls.

Disadvantages: The restaurant only has a fan, so it can get a bit hot. The tea cups are somewhat dirty at the rim.

textTranslated:
I've eaten here many times, but today I really can't help but leave a negative review because the cashier/waiter who served me was truly problematic.
Normally, when paying, the staff will guide customers to scan the QR code to use their old voucher and accumulate points for a new voucher.
But this time, the female staff member brought out the bill and asked me to transfer money to the QR code on the bill, without mentioning the voucher at all.
When I asked, she just pointed to the page opposite with a very large QR code printed on it – like: "There, if you want to accumulate points for a voucher for next time, do it yourself…" Seriously? 😬😬😬
She also didn't ask if I had a voucher from the previous visit, or if I had any vouchers or discount codes. The attitude was extremely uncooperative, even though I mentioned that on previous occasions they only used QR codes to apply vouchers.
But this person seemed to misunderstand or deliberately pretend not to understand, so in the end they didn't apply the voucher code and didn't even scan the QR code to apply it for future visits. The service throughout the meal was also extremely problematic. When I asked for extra eating utensils or anything else, I had to repeat myself 3-4 times... it seemed like they didn't understand anything about eating utensils or the restaurant's drink menu.
In short, I've eaten here many, many times, but this is the first time I've encountered such terrible staff.
I can't help but leave a negative review.

text:
We came here for dinner recently. I'm not usually a fan of hotpot so I didn't really expect much. My son wanted to try it. Our family of 3 ordered a 4 pot variation. My family ordered the "mala" but since I'm not a fan, we also got the original, mushroom, and pickled vegetables versions.

I'm not a red meat eater but my family is so they got beef, tongue as well as bone marrow, and blood cubes. I got some shrimp, fish paste with dill, and lots of vegetables.

The fish paste with dill was my favorite. In fact, I got another order. The fish balls with roe was delicious also.

There's a condiment bar where you can make your own dipping sauce. There were a few items that we're familiar with that wasn't offered: sesame sauce (although they had sesame seeds), dark vinegar, sate sauce (there was XO sauce).

I really enjoyed this meal and look forward to coming back and trying other varieties of "pastes" which all come in a "bamboo" tube.

어른들 조식때마다 따끈한 국물 너무 잘 드시길래.
의견 묻지 않고 훠궈 먹으러 가서
어른들은 버섯탕. 저는 스촨 선택.

너무 난감해 하길래 그냥 비용지불하고
더 먹었습니다.

참.. 잘 챙겨줬거든요.

소스 만드는 취향은 딱히 없지만
이런 곳 다니며 직원들 한테 부탁하면
맛있게 만들어줘서 싹싹 긁어먹었어요.

개인적으로 전 강유 보단 뮤단이 낫더라구요.
한국에 하이디라오 너무 번잡아서
전 다낭이나 나트랑가면 꼭 훠거 한끼이상
먹으니 한번 드셔보세요.
textTranslated:
I visited again and again.

The elders really enjoyed the warm soup every time we had breakfast, so without asking for their opinion, we went to eat hot pot.

The elders chose the mushroom soup, and I chose the Sichuan.

The service from all the staff was excellent.

I am always satisfied every time I visit.

The staff member accidentally checked one more item on the menu, so an extra plate of meat was served.

They looked so flustered, so I just paid the extra cost and ate more.

They really took good care of us.

I don't really have a preference for sauces, but whenever I go to places like this and ask the staff, they make them delicious, so I scraped every last bit clean.

Personally, I prefer Mudan over Gangyu.

Haidilao in Korea is too crowded, so whenever I go to Da Nang or Nha Trang, I always eat hot pot at least once.

You should give it a try.

text:
다낭 여행 중에 가장 맛있게 먹은 로컬 쌀국수집이에요! 관광객 없이 현지인들만 있던 현지인 맛집인 듯 해요. '퍼 거우', '퍼 남'으로 시켰는데 차돌박이 쌀국수와 양지 쌀국수인 것 같이요. 고수 빼달라는 말은 안 했어요! 쌀국수 모든 메뉴 6만동(3천원)입니다!

주문한 쌀국수 두 그릇과 숙주나물, 라임, 매콤한 맛이 나게 하는 칠리 고추(?)를 주셨어요. 국물을 먼저 한 입 먹어보았는데 정말 진하고 깊은 맛이었어요. 한국에 있는 베트남 쌀국수 집에서 파는 쌀국수는 비교도 안 될 정도로요. 진한 맛 때문인지 남자친구는 좀 짠 것 같다고 하더라고요. 사람마다 느끼는 차이가 있어서 그럴 수 있을 것 같아요. 고수를 잘 먹는 편이어서 고수 빼달라는 말 안 했는데 기본으로 들어있는 상태로 나왔어요. 고수 향이 은은하게 나서 국물 맛을 더 진하게 하는 것 같아요. 차돌박이와 양지 고기 모두 정말 부드러웠어요!

기본으로 제공되는 자스민 차도 시원하고 맛있었네요. 양파 절임이 테이블마다 구비되어 있었는데 양파 절임 안에 날파리 한 마리가 들어가있어서 먹진 않았어요. 베트남 로컬 식당에서는 어느 정도 감수해야할 부분이라 크게 신경쓰진 않았습니다. 무엇보다 쌀국수 맛이 정말 훌륭했기 때문에 또 생각날 것 같아요!!
textTranslated:
This is the most delicious local pho restaurant I ate at during my trip to Da Nang! It seemed like a local favorite, filled only with locals and no tourists. We ordered 'Pho Cau' and 'Pho Nam,' which I believe are beef brisket pho and flank pho. I didn't ask them to leave out the cilantro! All pho dishes are 60,000 VND (3,000 KRW)!

They served the two bowls of pho we ordered, along with bean sprouts, lime, and chili peppers (?) to add a spicy kick. I took a sip of the broth first, and it was incredibly rich and deep in flavor. It was incomparable to the pho sold at Vietnamese restaurants in Korea. Perhaps because of the rich flavor, my boyfriend said it tasted a bit salty. I suppose that could be because everyone's perception is different. Since I generally enjoy cilantro, I didn't ask them to leave it out, but it came out with it included by default. The subtle cilantro aroma seems to enhance the richness of the broth. Both the beef brisket and flank meat were incredibly tender!

The complimentary jasmine tea was refreshing and delicious. Pickled onions were provided on every table, but I didn't eat them because there was a gnat inside. However, since this is something you have to expect to some extent at a local Vietnamese restaurant, I didn't mind it too much. Above all, the pho was truly excellent, so I think I will be craving it again!!

textTranslated:
This is a rare restaurant with many kids, but it wasn't noisy 🍻 or maybe I was just lucky :))
The decor is very nice.
It's similar to Haidilao. There's a menu book or you can scan a QR code to order. There's a free self-service dipping sauce counter, but the refill speed isn't very fast, probably because it's busy during Tet (Vietnamese New Year). This counter is probably only half the size of Haidilao's, so it can't be compared.
Many dishes are similar to Haidilao's, even the food plates on the electronic menu are the same :))) The broth is different though; the mushroom and tomato broths are similar. Drinks are ordered separately.
In general, since Da Nang doesn't have Haidilao, eating here is okay. Good service, it seems to be owned by the same person as Kungfu Noodles.
Free parking, there's even an underground parking lot, and there's space for cars too.

肉類是相當新鮮，沾料一應俱全。如果目標是招待客人的話，這裡真的是很不錯的選擇。
但是缺點就是價位真的太高了，連我都覺得這樣的量收這個價格真的有點偏貴。對於想要大量過癮吃肉的人來說，還是建議考慮附近其他吃到飽火鍋店比較划算。
這裡有一個產品我真的要推薦，就是炒飯，炒出來的米粒有種很不可思議的Q彈，我一度認為是小麥或者小薏仁，但是店家堅持就是一般白米。我不信，請店家拿米粒讓我看，拿出來的米粒竟然真的就只是白米。很難想像廚師是怎樣處理這炒飯，能炒出這種粒粒分明，咀嚼留香彈牙的爽感，真的建議要點一份來試試看。
如果有人知道原因的話，也希望可以分享一下讓我解除我的迷惑。
textTranslated:
The food met the expected quality standards.

We ordered four different soup bases this time, and regardless of whether it was spicy or cheese, the broths faithfully represented their intended flavors, a significant difference compared to many other bland hot pot restaurants in the area.

The meat was very fresh, and the dipping sauces were plentiful. If you're looking to entertain guests, this is a great choice.

However, the downside is the price. Even I felt it was a bit expensive for the portion sizes. For those who want to indulge in a large amount of meat, I'd suggest considering other all-you-can-eat hot pot restaurants nearby for better value.

There's one dish I really want to recommend: the fried rice. The rice grains had an incredibly chewy and springy texture. I initially thought it was wheat or barley, but the restaurant insisted it was just regular white rice. I didn't believe them and asked the staff to show me the rice grains, and they were indeed just plain white rice. It's hard to imagine how the chef prepared this fried rice to achieve such distinct grains, a satisfyingly chewy and flavorful texture. I highly recommend ordering a serving to try it.

If anyone knows the reason, I hope they can share it so I can clear up my confusion.

textTranslated: First, I apologize for using words like "can we switch to someone else?". But I wasn't wrong about the issue. I think the restaurant wasn't very thoughtful about providing umbrellas for customers. I've eaten at many other restaurants, and they all have 3-4 umbrellas for staff to use or for customers to borrow when getting from their cars to the entrance. This restaurant only has one umbrella, and that's really inconvenient. That day, I noticed most customers got wet because the staff didn't provide umbrellas or lend them any. One customer who had just finished eating asked to borrow an umbrella to cross the street to buy a raincoat, but the staff member said, "The umbrella is for customers," with an unhappy attitude. Let me ask, are people who haven't eaten yet considered "customers," and those who have finished eating not? I hope the restaurant buys more umbrellas so everyone can move around more easily in the rain! Whether the restaurant deducts salaries or not is irrelevant. But the restaurant should address the root of the problem, not just the symptoms. Best regards <3

text: 바로 옆에 한국 사람들이 많이 가는 퍼홍이라는 쌀국수 가게가 있는데 웬만하면 한국 사람들에게 알려진 가게는 피하다 보니 찾아서 들어간 가게인데 숨겨진 맛집이다. 점심시간이 살짝 지나서 방문을 하니 사람은 없었고 요리를 하는 분으로 보이는 분이 자리를 안내해주면 한마디 했다. only beef noodle! 이 한마디에 기대감이 급상승했다. 위생이 딱히 좋은 편은 아니라서 위생에 민감한 분이라면 거부감이 있을 수 있으나 이곳은 그 거부감을 뛰어넘는 맛을 가지고 있다. 특이하게 쌀국수 위에 고명으로 파가 올려져 있어서 신기했는데 이게 또 신의 한 수처럼 시원한 맛을 내었다. 이것을 먹고 다음날 내내 이 쌀국수 생각이 났으나 여행 일정이 빠듯하여 아쉽게 다시 방문을 하지는 못했다. 해외에서 웬만하면 한 번 가본 식당은 다시 잘 안 가게 되는데 이곳은 다음번에 다낭에 방문하게 되면 필히 처음으로 다시 방문을 할 것 같다. 정말 개인적으로 강추하고 싶은 곳이다.
textTranslated: Right next door is a pho restaurant called Pho Hong that is popular with Koreans. Since I usually avoid places well-known to Koreans, I sought this place out and went in, and it turns out to be a hidden gem. I visited just after lunchtime, so there were no customers. A chef showed me to a seat and said, "Only beef noodles!" That single remark instantly raised my expectations. The hygiene isn't exactly top-notch, so those sensitive to hygiene might feel a bit put off, but the taste here surpasses that aversion. It was interesting to see green onions placed on top of the noodles as a unique garnish, and that turned out to be a stroke of genius, adding a refreshing flavor. I craved this pho all day the next day, but unfortunately, my travel schedule was tight, so I couldn't visit again. I usually don't go back to restaurants I've been to once when traveling abroad, but if I visit Da Nang again, I will definitely be visiting this place first. It is a place I personally highly recommend.

textTranslated:
Pho for 250 yen. I ate pho at many different places during my 8-day trip to Vietnam, but this is the best.

Other pho restaurants require calamansi, sauce, and garlic to get the authentic pho flavor, but this place's soup is delicious on its own. Adding the calamansi and chili peppers on the table makes it even better.

You absolutely can't find pho like this in Japan, and it's a flavor you don't often find even in Vietnam.

The only downside was that there was a bug in the pho. But considering they eat cow carcasses, it makes you wonder if it's fair to complain about a single fly.

The owner is really cool, and I was initially taken aback, but the taste speaks for itself. Seriously delicious. I highly recommend it.

text:
정말 국물이 맛있고...막 살갑게 친절한거는 아니지만...무뚝뚝하믄서 친절한~~국수맛은 끝내준다. 위생을 지적하는분들도 있지만 현지 상황을 봤을때...다 거기서 거기일듯...여기 한번 갔던 근처 호텔 사람들은 여기만 계속 가는듯...맛있으니까...주인 아저씨? 남자분이 다른말은 몰라도 no고수는 아신다.
국수시켜서 마늘이랑 라임이랑 칠리소스 섞어서 먹으면 끝냐준다. 처음 갔을때 너무 위화감없이 잘 먹고있었더니 뒤에 들어온 한국분들이 우리한태 현지 사시는 분이냐고 했을정도...ㅠㅠ 우리도 관광객이에요~~ㅋㅋㅋ 암튼 맛나다...위생문제는 알아서 해결하기~~^^;;; 베트남의 일반식당 위생은 다 거기서거기인듯~~
아참~~ 노고수 왜쳤다가...큰바구니에 실파 잘게썰어놓은게 보이길래... 파인줄알고 넣고 싶다했더니 고수란다...ㅠㅠ 난 파인줄 알았다...ㅋㅋㅋ
No고수 하심...1도 이상한맛 안나는 맛나는 쌀국수당~~^^
textTranslated:
The broth is really delicious... they aren't exactly overly friendly, but they are gruff yet kind~~ and the noodles taste amazing. Some people point out hygiene issues, but considering the local situation... it seems like they're all pretty much the same... People from nearby hotels who visited once seem to keep coming back here... because it's delicious... The owner? The man might not know other words, but he definitely knows "no cilantro."

Order the noodles, mix the garlic, lime, and chili sauce together, and it's just incredible. The first time I went, I was eating so comfortably that some Koreans who came in after us even asked if we lived there... ㅠㅠ We're tourists too~~ lol. Anyway, it's tasty... As for hygiene issues, you'll have to figure them out yourself~~^^;;; It seems like the hygiene of regular restaurants in Vietnam is all pretty much the same~~

Oh, by the way~~ I shouted "no cilantro"... then I saw some finely chopped scallions in a big basket... I thought they were green onions and asked to add them, but they told me they were cilantro... ㅠㅠ I thought they were green onions... lol.

They say "no cilantro"... it's delicious pho that doesn't taste strange at all~~^^

text:
다낭 퍼홍 바로 옆에있는 쌀국수 맛집입니다. 현지인들은 퍼홍보다 이곳 퍼기아를 더 찾는다고 하구요. 따로 영어메뉴판 이런게 없습니다.
제 경우에는 핸드폰으로 사진 보여주고, 원(1개) 이렇게 얘기해서 주문했었습니다.

퍼홍과 비교해 저는 맛이 큰차이는 못 느꼈습니다. 둘다 맛있었구요.
다른분들 평을 보니 퍼기아가 더 맛있다는 평가가 많았습니다.

1그릇에 5만동(2500원) 였습니다.

퍼홍, 퍼기아 둘다 06시면 문을 열어요.. 아침에 가면 사람도 적고, 선선해서 선풍기 밑에서 먹을만 합니다. 둘다 오픈형태의 가게이며, 에어컨은 없고, 선풍기만 있습니다.
textTranslated:
This is a popular pho restaurant located right next to Pho Hong in Da Nang. I heard that locals frequent Pho Gia more than Pho Hong. There is no separate English menu.

In my case, I ordered by showing a picture on my phone and saying "one" (one serving).

Compared to Pho Hong, I didn't notice a significant difference in taste. Both were delicious.

However, looking at other people's reviews, many said Pho Gia was tastier.

One bowl cost 50,000 VND (2,500 KRW).

Both Pho Hong and Pho Gia open at 6:00 AM. If you go in the morning, there are fewer people and it is cool, so it is pleasant to eat under the fans. Both are open-air establishments with no air conditioning, only fans.

현지 물가 생각하면 사실 음식값도 저렴한건 아니라는 생각이들었구요.
그러나 베트남에서 북경식 훠궈를 맛볼수있다는 점과 시설이 매우 깔끔하다는 점은 큰 장점이라 생각됩니다.
textTranslated:
Three of us—two adults and a 9-year-old girl—ate together, and the bill came out to just under 50,000 VND. We ordered 4 servings of beef (?), two types of noodles, two types of mushrooms, meatballs, and more, and ate until we were full. The vegetables and meat were fresh, and the staff were friendly.

However, if you compare it to a hot pot restaurant like Haidilao, it felt a bit lacking. The spiciness of the red broth was quite weak, and the flavor of the white broth was a bit bland.

Considering the local prices, I also felt that the food wasn't exactly cheap.

Nevertheless, I think the fact that you can taste Beijing-style hot pot in Vietnam and that the facilities are very clean are major advantages.

그런데, 바로 목격했어요.
왼쪽 귀 아래 흉터있는 20대후반 여성분이 식탁위를 치우는데, 손님이 마시고 남겼던 컵의 물을 국수그릇에 버리고 다시 식탁위 컵모듬쟁반에 올려두시더군요. 안보는 주방안에서는 어떤 상태일지 상상을 해버려서ㅜㅜ...가게내에 파리가 들끓는 이유는 사장으로 추정되는 남자분이 식탁위를 딱는 걸레와 걸레질하는걸 보면 ....ㅜㅜ (식탁아래 X자위에 걸쳐있는 검은물체가 걸레입니다.)
먹다가 뭔가 비위가 상해져서 반정도 먹다가 나왔어요. 먼지묻은 아주오래된 벽면 선풍기아래에 "최고의 쌀국수집"이라는 한국 신문기가가 붙어있는 아이러니....어느신문사 어느기자인지? 기레기겠죠?ㅋㅋㅋ
이 식당 절대 비추합니다.
textTranslated:
The taste is average. But the hygiene is... T.T
Before going, I read other people's reviews about hygiene, but I usually just assumed that was the case...
But then I saw it.
A woman in her late 20s with a scar below her left ear was clearing the table. She poured the water from a customer's cup into the noodle bowl and placed it back on the cup tray. I couldn't help but imagine what it must be like in the kitchen, out of sight. ㅜㅜ... The reason the restaurant is swarming with flies is because I saw a man, presumably the owner, mopping the table with a rag... ㅜㅜ (The black object draped in an X under the table is the rag.)
I felt a bit offended while eating, so I left halfway through. The irony was that under a dusty, old wall fan was a Korean newspaper sign that said "Best Pho Restaurant." Which newspaper, which reporter? It must be trash, lol.
I highly recommend this restaurant.

textTranslated: I saw many people on Instagram praising this restaurant, so I decided to try it out. However, I didn't make a reservation beforehand, so all the tables were taken. I ordered spicy hot pot broth and something else I can't remember. But the broth was delicious, except for the occasional spicy seed. The dipping sauces were also very special. Even better, there's a play area for kids! My family and I could enjoy our meal while my child played.

text: 이번 여행은 계획도 없긴 했지만 유난히 얼결에 들어간 집이 많았다. 맛사지 받고 호텔로 가는 길에  포홍에서 국수나 먹어보자 해서 갔는데 문을 닫고 있어서 걍 열려있는 옆집을 갔는데 알고보니 맛집. 간이 좀 세긴 하지만 깊고 깔끔했다. 마늘 넣은 생면스타일 좋아하는데 이집이 그렇다. 위생을 논하자면 씅에도 안찰 집은 맞다만 낮에 간 반세오 반두엉에 비하면 깨끗한 택이다. 크게 부푼 기대만 없다면 매우 만족할 수 있는 집이다. 주변에 호텔 덕인지 가격이 매우 싼 건 아니지만 그래봤자 떡볶이 한 접시 가격도 안된다.
textTranslated: Although I didn't really have a plan for this trip, I ended up wandering into an unusually large number of places by chance. On my way back to the hotel after a massage, I decided to grab some noodles at Pho Hong, but it was closed. So I just went to the place next door that was open, and it turned out to be a hidden gem. The seasoning was a bit strong, but the flavor was deep and clean. I like fresh noodles with garlic, and this place fits that description perfectly. If you were to nitpick about hygiene, it certainly wouldn't meet my standards, but it was much cleaner than Banh Xeo Banh Duong, which I visited earlier in the day. As long as you don't have overly high expectations, you will be very satisfied. Perhaps due to the nearby hotels, the prices aren't exactly cheap, but even so, it's less than the price of a single plate of tteokbokki.

textTranslated:
It's delicious. I was searching for Pho Hong on Google, but I wondered what was next door, and since the reviews were better, I ended up going here.

I haven't been to Pho Hong, so I can't compare the taste, but even though I usually can't eat pho, I ate it here. It has a very local vibe, and it was surprising that I could eat it even though there were only locals there. If you order it without toppings and go with "nam," it feels like eating in Korea, so it's not overwhelming. The broth is just like the beef soup served with raw beef at Gwangjang Market, lol.

Anyway, the whole family scraped the bowl clean, paid 200,000 VND, and left. That's about 10,000 won in Korean currency, haha. Highly recommended! Don't give up just because it looks a bit run-down!!

This is the original restaurant recognized by locals, and right next door is the Pho Hong 3rd Generation pho shop, which is incredibly popular with Korean tourists.

It is located in a small spot to the right of that shop and is not easily noticeable, so Koreans often mistake it for the place next door. However, locals say this is the original place they acknowledge. When I asked several Vietnamese locals, they all said this place was delicious. They mentioned that Pho Hong 3rd Generation opened later... When I went inside, I saw an article hanging on the wall that had been featured in a Korean magazine. It appeared to be a family-run business, and everyone seemed kind and friendly. The pho tasted very clean and light!

注意）
・正直お店は入りにくいです。店員さんにシンチャーと挨拶しながら入るといいでしょう。
・テーブルが凹んでる場所があります。こぼさないように。
・今のお茶はジャスミンです。コップは使い回しなので、フチを紙で拭いて、一回お茶を入れてゆすいでから飲みましょう。ダメな人はダメでしょうが^^;
textTranslated:
Ordering is in Vietnamese only, but you shouldn't have any problems.
1 bo nam (thinly sliced ​​beef pho)
or
1 bo gau (thinly sliced ​​beef, thigh portion? pho)
or
... That's all you need to say.

Here, fried bread isn't usually served, but instead, you get freshly boiled bean sprouts.

There's another pho shop next door, but this one has a richer beef flavor and the meat is more tender and delicious.
It's fantastic when paired with the pickled garlic side dish! (Though those sensitive to the smell might not be able to eat it at lunchtime.)

Prices have increased drastically recently; both shops used to charge 35k (small) but now it's 50k (large is 60k). The time to enjoy it cheaply and deliciously is becoming limited...

Note:
* Honestly, the shop is a bit intimidating to enter. It's best to greet the staff with "Xin cha" (hello) as you go in.
* Some tables have indentations. Be careful not to spill anything.

The tea we're serving right now is jasmine. Since the cups are reused, please wipe the rim with paper, pour in the tea once, rinse, and then drink. I know some people might not like that, though ^^;

text:
照片的炸春捲是錯誤的，這裡並沒有提供。

北越風味的河內河粉，是加上油條、豆芽、蒜頭切片，輔佐檸檬汁或魚露。與中樂的河粉是加上大量生菜食用而有所不同。尤其是蒜頭切片跟油條，大力推薦！蒜頭因為有泡醋的關係，所以並沒有原本的刺鼻嗆辣，反倒是一種溫和又濃厚的大蒜香味；油條也不像台灣油條般油膩，油非常少，但也相對沒那麼酥脆，但是口味清淡喜好者的好選擇，我個人很喜歡。

原本也不懂怎麼吃，但同桌的越南當地人用很標準的中文說明食用方法，非常感謝他，也感受到難得的越南人熱情，而不是為了賺你錢的那種「熱情」。

用餐時段的人潮非常多，感覺出來是一家非常平價美味的道地牛肉河粉。
textTranslated:
The spring rolls in the photo are incorrect; they are not served here.

North Vietnamese-style Hanoi pho includes fried dough sticks, bean sprouts, and sliced ​​garlic, served with lemon juice or fish sauce. This differs from the pho in Chung Lok, which is served with a large amount of raw vegetables. The sliced ​​garlic and fried dough sticks are especially recommended! Because the garlic is pickled in vinegar, it doesn't have the usual pungent spiciness, but rather a mild and rich garlic aroma. The fried dough sticks are also less oily than Taiwanese fried dough sticks, with very little oil, but they are also less crispy. However, they are a good choice for those who prefer a lighter flavor, and I personally enjoyed them.

I didn't know how to eat it at first, but the local Vietnamese at my table explained the method in fluent Chinese. I was very grateful to him and felt the rare warmth of the Vietnamese people, not the kind of "warmth" that's just to make money off you.

The restaurant was very crowded during mealtime, indicating that it's a very affordable and delicious authentic beef pho restaurant.
address: 35 Lý Tự Trọng, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam
title: Pho Viet Beo
